verdict.rationale: smolagents is a library that can run fully local LLMs through `transformers` or `ollama`. That lets a user keep prompts and data on their own machine and away from any provider that might train on them. This is an indirect route rather than a documented privacy control, and with hosted providers (OpenAI, Anthropic and others via LiteLLM) training use depends on each provider's own policy. missing for 10: an explicit no-training or data-usage policy, documented opt-out controls for hosted inference, guidance on provider data retention, and independent corroboration.
